implementation: One shared value-ownership helper serves row, run and vector backends for LAG, LEAD, FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE and NTH_VALUE, including defaults and IGNORE NULLS.

Per-probe expression scopes release skipped candidates and null-check scratch immediately. Selected payloads transfer to a result scope retained through streaming suspension and awaited checkpoint writes.

Equal immutable scalar outputs reuse the retained value and its reservation. Mutable values use owned detachment. Failed backend construction rolls back new allocations without releasing pre-existing caller allocations.
